text:
maria: FYI seeing increased 504 rate from dedicated eu-west1 inference pool since ~03:10 UTC. Looks tied to the new prefix-cache allocation bump in v3.2.1. Want to push tiny revert hotfix: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-revert.1. Requesting expedited canary + rollforward if healthy.
ash: pls paste a minimal error sample and the rollback steps. also propose canary plan.
maria: sample logs:\n```
2026-03-24T03:11:12Z inference-4 error: kv_prefix_alloc > cap -> reclaim -> request timeout 504
2026-03-24T03:11:13Z inference-5 warn: http upstream closed during response
```\nimage: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-revert.1
rollback: pin image back to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy. runbook ticket: RB-342 "hotfix-rollback".
diego: canary size? normally 10% but this is EU-only. Suggest 2 pods in eu-west1 (small footprint) with 15m watch, then ramp to 50% for 10m then full if green. do we want autoscaler off on the canary?
maria: yes disable autoscaler on canary, enforce previous mem limit 7Gi. start now if oncall happy.
qa-bot: CI check: unit+smoke passed on image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-revert.1. Preflight script included in PR.
ash: approving canary deployment. :thumbsup: Will monitor p95/p99 and 5xx. I'll keep rollback steps ready.
ops-bot: @maria assigned oncall until 2026-03-24T06:00Z. Hooks enabled: 5xx-rate, p99-latency, node-memory.
deploybot: Deploy requested by maria -> eu-west1 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-revert.1. Canary healthchecks on, observing 15m.
(deploybot pauses)
deploybot: 03:19 UTC: canary 2/2 ready. healthchecks passed. 5xx trending down.
maria: good. leaving dashboards open.
diego: running memory probe every 2m. no OOM signals yet.
03:34 UTC - deploybot: 15m observation complete. metrics baseline stable. ash: you ok to ramp to 50%?
ash: +1 from SRE. go to 50% and observe 10m.
deploybot: ramping eu-west1 -> 50% traffic. will monitor for 10m.
03:45 UTC - deploybot: 10m observation complete. notes: 5xx down ~88% from peak, latency unchanged, no new OOM traces recorded.
maria: proceeding to full rollout for eu-west1, keeping a 10m final watch. ops, be ready to trigger RB-342 rollback.
diego: I'm standing by. dashboards open.
ash: final approval granted. tagging docs team for release note.
ops-bot: changelog reminder: add note to internal changelog page before full rollout complete.
03:56 UTC - deploybot: full rollout to eu-west1 complete. image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-revert.1. No alerts during watches.
qa-bot: automated smoke verification after rollout OK.
maria: added postmortem ticket to track test coverage gap and CI integration for prefix-cache changes (PM: create follow-up tests). release note draft: "v3.2.1-revert.1: revert prefix-cache allocation bump causing 504s under specific EU traffic patterns. No API changes."
ash: thanks all. marking this thread resolved once changelog is published.
diego: changelog entry live. closing monitoring window in 30m if stable.
ops-bot: thread marked RESOLVED by maria. :white_check_mark:
